ground_truth_facts.work: Train A travels 60 mph for t+1 hours; Train B travels 80 mph for t hours; 60(t+1)+80t=280; 140t=220; t=1.57h; Train B leaves at 10AM + 1.57h ≈ 11:34AM... recalc: 60(t+1)+80t=280, t=220/140=11/7h from 10AM = ~11:34 but check: at 12PM, A traveled 3h×60=180mi, B traveled 2h×80=160mi, 180+160=340≠280, so recalc needed; correct: 60(1+t)+80t=280; 60+60t+80t=280; 140t=220; t=11/7 from 10AM = 10:00 + 94.3min ≈ 11:34 AM
